system.model: Developed against a local llama3.2 via Ollama to avoid rate limits.

capabilities.name: pre-processing and tagging
capabilities.claim: Process inbox and extracts message to tag for the actionable group

capabilities.name: Determinsitc routing
capabilities.claim: Reads a thread and extracts message to tag for the routing action

capabilities.name: Follow-up tracking for unanswered sent mail
capabilities.claim: Execute to complete the actions after dry run
capabilities.observable: logs each message action in trace.json

capabilities.name: dry run the pipeline by the above processors input->routing->gated-action
capabilities.observable: Routes a meeting request to a dry-run or preference-preserving action rather than sending it directly.
capabilities.evidence: Prepares and agentic email by checking all the emails in the thread with latest thread to be replied

capabilities.name: Execute the whole pipeline for automated inbox processing
capabilities.claim: Generates the dashboard for the processed message how many proceessed
capabilities.observable: Execute the whole InboxHero Pipeline and make the Dashboard for processed messages

capabilities.name: Unread mail from a sender
capabilities.claim: Lists unread mail from a specific sender so the user can quickly assess incoming action items without scanning the whole inbox.
capabilities.observable: Returns only the unread mail from that sender, filtering out read messages and other senders.
capabilities.evidence: List all the unreadmails from specific sender

capabilities.name: Unreplied emails
capabilities.claim: Find messages that were sent and never answered after the requested wait period and draft a chase for each.
capabilities.observable: Routes a meeting request to a dry-run or preference-preserving action rather than sending it directly.
capabilities.evidence: Lists all the emails with the waiting time

capabilities.name: Capability - Commitments and Deadline with auto-reply subject
capabilities.claim: Extract concrete commitments and deadlines from message threads.
capabilities.evidence: prints the commitment list for sam@paperjet.io and generates the subject by looking in to the respective threads
